title: Arroyo Seco Water Reuse Project motion
text:
[Arroyo Seco Water Reuse Project motion]
MOTION

I MOVE that the Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners hereby instruct the staff
of the Department of Recreation and Parks to present to the Board for its consideration
a resolution formally opposing the use of park land owned by the Department of
Recreation and Parks in connection with the Cities of Pasadena’s and South
Pasadena’s Arroyo Seco Water Reuse Project as currently contemplated under the
project’s Environmental Impact Report.

Presented by:  ________________________
  Luis Sanchez, President
